note: Doors, windows and archways that are generated rather than downloaded
(RM-008 F1). Kept out of catalog.json deliberately: that file is the list
of model FILES this build ships, and every test over it asserts exactly
that - the thumbnails exist, the formats are all glTF, and there is a
frozen r98 merge reading for each one. A parametric opening has no file,
so putting it there would mean weakening six suites to accommodate a row
that is not what they are about.
Each row states only what differs from the kind's defaults in
items/opening.js. A door is 90 x 210, a window 120 x 120 on a 900 sill,
and normaliseOpening fills the rest in where the item is built - so a row
is 'a door, hinged right' rather than a full record repeated six times.
